established: Five role-specific static OwnerConfig plans with disjoint root/key identifiers and independently pinned public credentials
Opaque static plans, scoped signing intents and non-invoking Signer/OwnedStore/client-port bindings
Four-phase Ed25519 transcript and one-shot challenge/channel correspondence, including both boots/key epochs and registry digest
Closed stage tables, predecessor receipt closure, ledger-first retry resolution and non-circular post-commit receipt derivation
Same-operation fresh-session recovery with fixed deadlines, one-recovery cap and retained context floor
Version-2 conservative byte, frame, request, signature and storage-stage budget planning
limitations: No key loader, OS preflight, file-store writer, journal commit, Anchor CAS or production owner kernel is executed
No nonce/challenge/sequence table, atomic reservation, replay-state mutation, real connection or two-child service pair is implemented
Channel metadata validation binds canonical inner bytes/domain/API/lineage; complete inner payload validation and runtime authorization remain mandatory
A validated stage receipt represents structurally consistent hypothetical facts, not observed durable storage or live authority
Budget schedule selected-source-read-v1 is a static worst-case plan; binding the actual runtime call graph, reserving/consuming quotas and measuring throughput remain C3b-1/5 and C3d work
Context observations must already be accepted by the domain-specific authenticated client; the floor helper does not authenticate a raw observation
No separate UID isolation, independent rollback domain, actual authority handoff, Task/BTA/OSV connection, read skipping or adoption

budgetAndRecoveryReviewFix.rootCause: bounded-full-read-v1 charged every chunk 20 provider and 24 issuer requests (all eight retained prepares) against the 256 per-actor request limit, so at most 40,960 bytes were admissible and the C2 end-to-end source (41,452 bytes) was refused
budgetContract: Algorithm selected-source-read-v1 replaces bounded-full-read-v1; the old ID is rejected rather than reinterpreted
A read verifies only the selected source: per chunk reader 1, provider 2, checkpoint-issuer 1, authority-broker 1, lineage-registry 0, plus fixed and one reserved request per actor
The admissible closure is derived from the per-actor request limit: 126 chunks (516,096 bytes); one chunk more is refused
The C2 fixture source size is admitted under the plan
budgetAndRecoveryReviewFix.recoveryContract: Session recovery requires nowMs + recoveryHandshakeMs + remainingWorkMs to fit before both the operation deadline and the pin expiry
budgetAndRecoveryReviewFix.challengeContract: Challenge exchange permission now matches API, purpose, lineage and delegate instance, as the channel frame already did
